name: reasoning_marathon_then_giant_script
source: audit F1/F2 shape: a reasoning model thinks for five minutes in the first round, then (after the retry) writes the whole enclosure as ONE script that the output limit cuts off. Synthesized: no user data, sizes and timings are the real shape.
prompt: Make a base plate and a tube clamp for a 20 mm tube.

rounds.note: 20 reasoning events of 300 characters, 15 s apart: 300 s in total, far under the character limit
the retry at reasoning=off: the model writes everything as one script and the reply is cut

events.text: I will write the whole bracket as one script.

rounds.note: told to split: one small call per part
second part as a short script

args.code:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
d = App.getDocument('{doc}')
t = d.addObject('Part::Cylinder', 'Clamp')
t.Radius = 10
t.Height = 25
d.recompute()

events.text: Built the base plate and the tube clamp.
